notes:
Summary: Mid-market ITSM vendor building internal IT/helpdesk chatbot (HelpChain) to reduce L1 ticket volume and speed engineer responses. Evaluating Redwood hosted API as first step for fast time-to-value; likely move to Dedicated (reserved) for predictable latency once POC passes. Key POC goals: streaming + tool-calling reliability, p95 latency targets, audit logs and retention controls.

POC scope (agreed):
- 2-week hosted API POC (prod-like request mix)
- Instrument streaming responses and tool calling (ticket lookup, runbook fetch)
- Measure p50/p95/p99 latency for short chat responses and tool-augmented answers
- Verify audit log schema (who asked, tool calls made, KV cache hits) and retention hooks (1 year default, configurable)

Performance targets (customer stated):
- p95 latency for single-turn short responses < 200ms (streaming enabled to improve perceived latency)
- end-to-end tool call latency including DB lookup < 350ms ideally
- sustained throughput target ~150 req/s during business hours; burst to 400 req/s acceptable with fallback

Security / compliance asks: SSO (SAML), per-request audit logs (immutable), configurable retention windows, KMS integration for envelope keys, ability to pin EU region for data residency on Dedicated. Air-gapped not required now but VPC + private control plane preferred for Dedicated.

Quotes / call snippets:
- "We need chat answers fast — engineers won't wait 1s+ to see a suggested fix." (CTO, 2026-01-29)
- "If audit logs are easy and retention is configurable, we can push to prod quickly." (Head of InfoSec)

Commercial / procurement:
- Interested in hosted to start (cost-sensitive) but will buy Dedicated if latency/SLAs require it. Requested committed capacity pricing for predicted traffic. Estimated ARR range provided.

Next steps (short):
- AE (Maya) to schedule POC kickoff (week of 2026-03-01).
- SE (Diego) to deliver test harness + streaming/instrumentation checklist.
- Security team to validate audit log schema (SEC-1193).
- Finance to send sample Dedicated pricing scenarios.

Open questions / blockers:
- Confirm p95 target achievable on hosted vs Dedicated under realistic load (needs benchmark).
- Clarify how function/tool-call traces are surfaced in audit logs (format).
- Solidify EU data residency approach for customers in EMEA.

Attachments / refs: Fireflies ff_2026-01-29_ironclad_demo, pricing deck in Drive, Gmail thread with security questions (thread-CAJk3f9_ironclad-security).
